metadata.title: Neratinib Therapy
metadata.indication: Extended adjuvant treatment of adults with early-stage HR-positive, HER2-overexpressed/amplified breast cancer who completed adjuvant trastuzumab-based therapy less than one year ago.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled encoding · independent clinical and pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Source-specific oral dosing, toxicity history, eligibility and supportive care; source conflicts require specialist review.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

source_supplements.title: EMA Nerlynx product information
source_supplements.scope: Breast monotherapy; formulation, organ function, interactions and unresolved NCCP/SmPC differences

metadata.schedule_summary: Neratinib is taken once daily with food for one year. The usual starting dose is 240 mg; the team may interrupt or reduce it for toxicity. Treatment starts less than one year after completing adjuvant trastuzumab.
source_boundaries: NCCP Child-Pugh C 33% conflicts with EMA contraindication; no automatic dosing.
NCCP CrCl<30/dialysis no-adjustment expectation conflicts with EMA not-recommended use; require specialist review.
NCCP grade-3 diarrhoea rows overlap exactly at two days.
The count table prints ANC≤0.9 AND platelets≤99; discordant/missing counts require review rather than converting the source AND to OR.
Hepatic table is ALT, not a combined ALT/AST rule. Use source CTCAE v4.0 and explicit ULN thresholds.
NCCP/EMA return-to-240mg interaction wording requires review if the pre-interaction dose had already been reduced.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

hypersensitivity.label: Hypersensitivity to this medicine or excipients

renal_input.reason: Continuous entry preserves the source renal thresholds; EMA defines the exact half-open CrCl bands and clarifies the severe-impairment limitations.

diarrhoea_grade.label: Diarrhoea grade
diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Count stools per day above the patient's baseline, assess ostomy output, continence, hydration, fever, abdominal pain, haemodynamic compromise and whether hospital care is indicated.

hand_foot_grade.label: Palmar-plantar erythrodysaesthesia grade
hand_foot_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess painful erythema, swelling, hyperkeratosis, peeling or blistering of palms/soles and the effect on instrumental or self-care activities.

other_toxicity_grade.label: Other treatment-related toxicity grade
other_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade the actual named event using CTCAE v4.0. Excludes diarrhoea and hepatotoxicity, which have separate source tables.

alt_grade.label: ALT elevation grade (NCCP CTCAE v4.0; not AST)
alt_grade.assessment_guidance: NCCP Table 6 specifies ALT >5–20 × ULN for grade 3 and >20 × ULN for grade 4. Do not silently substitute AST.

bilirubin_grade.label: Bilirubin elevation grade
bilirubin_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the measured bilirubin and laboratory ULN; account for an abnormal baseline where CTCAE specifies a baseline-relative definition and assess the overall hepatic pattern.

gi_disease_diarrhoea.label: GI disease with diarrhoea as major symptom

complicated_diarrhoea.label: Complicated diarrhoea features (dehydration, fever, hypotension, renal failure or grade 3-4 neutropenia)

pretreatment_tests_unresolved.label: Required blood tests / eligibility checks unresolved

hr_positive_her2_positive.label: HR-positive and HER2-overexpressed/amplified early breast cancer confirmed

baseline_lvef_normal.label: Baseline LVEF within the local normal range

diarrhoea_optimal_therapy.label: Diarrhoea persists despite optimal medical treatment

diarrhoea_recurrence.label: Diarrhoea has recurred after prior resolution/restart

diarrhoea_recovery_days.label: Days to diarrhoea recovery to grade 0–1

hepatic_grade3_recurrence.label: Grade 3 ALT/bilirubin has recurred despite one dose reduction

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
summary: Mandatory early anti-diarrhoeal prophylaxis: loperamide from the first dose, titrated to 1-2 bowel movements/day
Hydration, diet and rapid diarrhoea escalation advice
supportive_care.provenance: National NCCP antiemetic guidance is linked for antiemetic support. Confirm regimen specific supportive care against the current NCCP protocol and applicable local policy.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP oral classification v6 Table 8: minimal-to-low; diarrhoea prevention is a separate requirement.
regimen_specific_notes: Loperamide from the first dose: NCCP weeks 1–2 4 mg three times daily; weeks 3–8 4 mg twice daily; weeks 9–52 4 mg as required. Titrate to 1–2 bowel movements/day and provide individual maximum-dose/escalation instructions.
FBC monthly for six months then every three months. LFTs at week 1, monthly for three months, then every six weeks. Extra tests are needed for toxicity.
Baseline renal/hepatic profile; cardiac function/LVEF when clinically indicated. Do not copy a routine trastuzumab echo calendar.
Take whole tablets with food, preferably morning. Do not replace missed doses. Review acid suppression, CYP3A4/P-gp medicines, grapefruit and pomegranate.
CONTROL dose escalation is evidence for tolerability but is not the 240 mg initial schedule printed in NCCP v2; any alternative requires local approval.

treatment_phases.label: Neratinib continuous oral treatment
treatment_phases.duration_text: For 1 year, unless progression or unacceptable toxicity

administration.notes: Neratinib 240 mg orally once daily with food for one year, starting within one year after adjuvant trastuzumab; prescribed reductions or interruption may be needed. The 28-day display is a review block, not a tablet-free interval.
